Join us for an elevated bridal expo experience in Riverside on Jan 24th—designed for the modern bride who values style, detail, and unforgettable moments.
Enjoy thoughtfully designed activations that go beyond the traditional bridal show. From immersive experiences to hand-selected vendors, every element has been crafted to inspire and delight as you plan your big day.
To create a more relaxed and intentional experience, entry is organized by ticketed time slots. You’ll select your preferred arrival window at checkout, allowing you to plan your day with ease while enjoying a more personalized flow throughout the event.
Expect a fresh, hospitality-driven atmosphere where you can connect, explore, and celebrate this exciting chapter—surrounded by beautiful details and a few surprises along the way.
